status.gpu_accessible_description: Current GPU availability and device name.

accessibility.status_description: Shows GPU, VRAM, active model, and audio output status.
accessibility.command_bar_description: Shows the active project, autosave interval, compute state, and privacy mode.
accessibility.compute_description: Reports whether generation is using a GPU or CPU.
accessibility.privacy_description: Reports local processing or strict offline mode.
accessibility.last_notification_description: Keeps the most recent notification readable after its toast closes.

output.audio_device_help: Uses PortAudio and shows the host API so similarly named devices are distinguishable.
output.enumeration_failed: Could not enumerate audio output devices; playback will use the system default until the list is refreshed. ({error})
output.saved_unavailable: Saved output device '{identity}' is unavailable; playback will use the system default until it returns.
output.no_devices: No PortAudio output devices were found; playback will use the system default.

gpu.hf_token_help: Required for gated models (Stable Audio Open). Get yours at huggingface.co/settings/tokens

appearance.experience_help: Controls default UI complexity across all modules
appearance.ui_language_help: Changes the interface language and applies right-to-left layout when supported. Restart to rebuild translated views.
appearance.default_lyrics_language_help: Used by Quick lyrics generation and new voice-clone language metadata.
appearance.reduced_motion_help: Disables sliding and repositioning animations for notifications.

lyrics.temperature_help: Higher = more creative, lower = more predictable

song_forge.timestep_shift_help: ACE-Step XL Turbo schedule shift (1, 2, or 3)

cache.max_size_help: Refuse new model downloads when the cache would exceed this limit
cache.autosave_enabled: Autosave the open project on the interval
cache.autosave_help: Saves and versions the open project only when it has unsaved changes.
cache.max_versions_help: Oldest autosaves are pruned first; pre-restore versions are always kept.

recovery.intro: Jobs, logs, crash reports, settings backups, and project versions are bounded by age, count, and size. Preview always runs first; active, recoverable, and pre-restore records are never removed.
recovery.preview_summary: Preview only — nothing removed. {count} item(s) would be removed, freeing {size} MB.

messages.locale_changed: Interface language saved. Restart Slunder Studio to rebuild all translated views.

credentials.available: Secrets are stored in {backend}. They are never written to config JSON, backups, or diagnostics.
credentials.unavailable: No OS credential service is available, so secrets cannot be stored.
